correctness.rationale: Given Brownian observations, each interior interval is a Brownian bridge with integrated variance h^3/12 and the terminal interval is a free Brownian increment with integrated variance h^3/3. The exact gap functional follows. Strict convexity with weights 1,...,1,4 yields unique gaps 2/(2n+1) and 1/(2n+1), including n=1 and all equal strata. Independent exact polynomial integration yields E W=3/2, E W^2=127/28, E W_iW_{i+1}=449/336, giving long-run variance 11/24 and CLT 11/3456 after division by 144. Bounded 1-dependence supplies CLT and even/odd strong laws. These identities were independently recomputed symbolically.

value.rationale: Quantifies exact expected loss and its fluctuations when replacing optimal Brownian-kernel quadrature nodes with simple randomized stratification. Distinguishes finite-design effects from conditional path uncertainty and gives a reusable explicit design coefficient.
